tasks.label: npm install (all)
args: set -euo pipefail; npm install --prefix pdf-mcp-server; npm install --prefix db-mcp-server; npm install --prefix finops-mcp-server

tasks.label: git: init and push origin (force)
args:
set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/david/Documents/TruckerAI
if [ ! -d .git ]; then git init; fi
git checkout -B main
if git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git remote set-url origin https://github.com/bmw330i/TruckerAI
else
  git remote add origin https://github.com/bmw330i/TruckerAI
fi
git add .
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "No changes to commit"
else
  git commit -m "Initial scaffold: MCP servers (pdf, db, finops) and env setup"
fi
# Force push so origin exactly matches local main
git push -u origin +main
